name_am: ዱብቲ ጠቅላላ ሆስፒታል – የተቀናጀ አገልግሎት ማዕከል (One-Stop Centre)
source_name: Amref Health Africa — "USAID Transform: Health in Developing Regions Program Launches GBV One-Stop Centre in Afar Region" (12 April 2019)
source_text_original: USAID Transform: Health in Developing Region program launched a one-stop centre at Dubti hospital in Afar region to provide medical treatment, psychosocial and legal services to those who undergo Gender-Based Violence (GBV) in an integrated approach. Working in close collaboration with Afar Regional Health Bureau and Dubti General Hospital, the program established the centre to deliver a coordinated response to survivors of sexual assaults in particular.
notes_en: The source is from 2019 and the programme that set it up was USAID-funded; whether the centre still runs has not been confirmed. Phone, hours and cost are not stated.
notes_am: ምንጩ ከ2019 ሲሆን ያቋቋመው ፕሮግራም በUSAID የተደገፈ ነበር፤ ማዕከሉ አሁንም እየሠራ መሆኑ አልተረጋገጠም። ስልክ፣ የሥራ ሰዓትና ዋጋ አልተገለጹም።

source_text_original: Semera Afar national region semera city supreme court of afar on first flor … We provide free legal advice and representation to all women and girls, ensuring equitable access to justice across both development and crisis-affected environments.
